text:
sarah: FYI customer (Acme Search) just escalated — rerank p95 spiked ~3.8s during a traffic burst and they saw a bunch of 502/504s from the gateway. They say it started ~09:12 UTC and recurred every 30–60s for ~10m. attaching quick notes.

james: can you paste a sample request + the exact error they saw? any correlation id? :eyes:

sarah: here's the repro curl they used (redacted API key). they reported gateway 504s and some 502s.
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "query": "find similar docs",
    "candidates": ["doc1","doc2",...,"doc20"],
    "top_k": 5
  }'
```
Error in gateway logs: `upstream timeout`, and in customer logs they show `HTTP 504` for ~12% of requests during spike. No auth or billing issues. They said request QPS peaked from 50 -> 320 for a 2m window.

leo: grabbing gateway traces now. I can already see a pattern: many requests hit the rerank backend and waited on `kvcache.get` and then connection timeouts to model-hosts. stack excerpts:
```
[proxy] 2024-04-11T09:12:27Z upstream timeout waiting for response from 10.12.3.45: context deadline exceeded
[router] 2024-04-11T09:12:28Z retrying request to rerank-pool-2 (conn_pool exhausted)
```

maya: likely root cause: connection pool exhaustion on the rerank proxy + backend latency amplification when candidate count is large. rerank calls with 20 candidates x concurrent QPS creates many parallel model inferences (or KV cache loads). we had a known hotspot where large candidate lists bypass cache and create N model calls instead of 1. Suggest temporary mitigations: reduce max_candidates per request (client-side), add server-side request bounding (reject >12 candidates with 429), and enable per-customer concurrency cap. Also add an emergency routing rule to send this customer to lower-cost model-variant with smaller memory footprint.

james: can we reproduce in staging? i'll spin up a synthetic load with same payload distribution and sizes. if we can hit the same p95 and conn_pool logs we can validate fix. leo — can you attach the proxy config (conn pool size, timeouts)?

leo: proxy conf snippet
```
upstream.rerank.conn_pool_size = 100
upstream.rerank.request_timeout = 2s
upstream.rerank.max_parallel_infers = 16
```
Looks like peaks exhausted the 100 conn pool because many long-tail requests were blocking for >2s.

sarah: customer asked for immediate mitigation — they prefer a config change over code. can we do a quick hotfix? throttle at gateway to smooth bursts.

engops-bot: Created incident INC-2024-217 and linked alert -> paging on-call. Autoscaler triggered +2 nodes at 09:14 UTC.

james: temp mitigation plan (actionable):
- add a gateway rate-limit for this org to 120 QPS (from 320 bursts) via per-customer quota (runtime config) — short window (15m)
- enable request coalescing for identical rerank payloads (if available)
- enforce server-side candidate cap = 12 (config flag) and return 400/429 with guidance
- scale rerank backend pool from 100 -> 200 connections while we investigate

maya: long-term: add heuristics in router to rewrite large-candidate requests into a two-stage flow: prefix-rank (embedding) + shortlist, then rerank top N. also investigate KV cache hotspots for large candidate lists.

sarah: customer ok with temporary rate-limit and candidate cap. they requested timeline: ASAP (within 30m) for a temporary throttle and a follow-up plan.

james: I'll own emergency changes. I'll push gateway throttle and candidate cap now, then run synthetic repro. if we still see >5% 5xx, escalate to model infra for deeper kernel/quantization checks.

leo: after applying throttle and cap, proxy logs show conn_pool free during a small test run. will validate under load.

sarah: thanks — i've updated the customer and created support ticket SUP-1452 linking INC-2024-217. leaving notes: customer will not be billed for any degraded requests during incident window.

maya: postmortem action items:
- (P0) Add per-org burst protection (config + UI)
- (P1) Improve rerank backend backpressure and coalescing
- (P2) Add synthetic test with large-candidate workloads to perf suite

james: ETA for rollback to normal config: monitor 1h after deploy. will report back in this thread with numbers (p50/p95/p99 and 5xx%).

sarah: ack. thanks team. :thumbsup:
